rationale: The strongest candidates are nearby disapproval memoranda that share a general equality rationale or conclude by favoring different legislation, but none supplies distinctive language, a sufficiently parallel substantive sequence, or the same legal machinery. Their similarities are characteristic of veto-message drafting and do not establish a concrete, material template for the later memorandum.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I HAVE WITHHELD my approval of S. 906
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I HAVE WITHHELD my approval from S. 3064
shared_material.explanation: C03 shares the conventional opening formula, but this is routine veto-message language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Government would then be on exactly the same basis under that section as all other shippers
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Uniformity and equality of treatment under general law applicable equally to all must be the steadfast rule
shared_material.explanation: C03 shares an equality-under-general-law rationale, but it concerns private veterans legislation and does not reproduce the child's rate-review machinery or argument sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I see no reason why the Government should not be subject to the same limitations ... as the commercial shipper
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Uniformity and equality of treatment to all who are similarly situated must be the steadfast rule
shared_material.explanation: C18 has a similar nondiscrimination principle, but the shared idea is generic and the operative legal contexts differ materially.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I recommend that such legislation be enacted at the next Session of the Congress
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope that the Congress will, at its next session, give further consideration to legislation to accomplish the purposes of H.R. 6839
shared_material.explanation: C20 likewise rejects a bill while inviting corrected legislation at the next session, a routine administrative conclusion rather than a distinctive template.
